entities.summary: Sergei Rudolfovich Shabanov is a Belarusian professional ice hockey goaltender who participated at the 2010 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Belarus men's national ice hockey team. He also played for Belarus at the 2002 Winter Olympics in Salt Lake City.
